creator: Skoottie
client_context: Historical new-pack test server, identified in the video description; not a v0.46 build fixture.
evidence_kind: Browser-played video screenshots, candidate attack pulses visually reviewed; no downloaded video.
scope: Global exchange-limit and post-attack-summon ordering component only. Tapir and other recorded pets are outside the thirty-pet curriculum, so this is not a full simulated replay of the recorded teams.

timeline.560: Turn 12 shop ends with eight trophies and six lives.
timeline.562-565: Transition into battle; before first exchange.
timeline.566.25: First front-pet exchange, including Pepper survival; not a start-of-battle ability shot.
timeline.575-578: Player opens game menus. Menu text creates false positive red-pixel pulses; these were excluded by visual inspection.
timeline.578.44: Sixth exchange, initially merged with a menu pulse by the rough detector; separately replayed at 578-580 and visually confirmed.
timeline.606.65: Thirtieth and final exchange; both front Tapirs faint.
timeline.608: Both front replacements exist, with the opponent's summon buff resolved to 5/4; no further exchange.
timeline.613: Draw overlay, pets alive on both sides, eight trophies and six lives unchanged.
timeline.620: Next shop, turn 13, same trophies and lives.

method_limits: Frame times are approximate (~0.2-second screenshot cadence), not exact animation onsets. The initial 75-pixel detector returned 31 candidates: two were menus and one real attack was merged into a menu pulse. All remaining candidate images and the separately captured missing attack were visually inspected. Thresholds 150/250/400/500 independently extract the same thirty pulses from the recorded metrics. Initial playback failed near the end; 606-613 was separately replayed through the visible Draw result. This does not establish the current client version, or natural win/loss precedence on exchange 30.
